newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Multisource soars on restructuring news.
newsitem.headline: Multisource soars on restructuring news.

text.p: Shares in South African telecommunications firm Multisource Holdings Ltd surged to a new year high on Friday following an announcement that the company was on the verge of a restructuring, dealers said.
It was the highest percentage gainer on the Johannesburg Stock Exchange (JSE) despite announcing poor year results earlier on Friday.
By 0814 GMT Multisource shares were up 28.57 percent or 100 cents at 450 cents on a volume of 11,000 shares.
"I think they are up on that restructuring announcement they've made," one dealers said.
Dealers said the market seemed to have seen some positivity on the move despite Multisource's results.
Earnings per share for the year-ended February 28 were down at 25.5 cents compared to 37.9 cents previously and the dividend dropped to nine cents from 21.0 cents.
"Yes their results were bad but I think they've moved on the restructuring arrangements," a dealer said.

Newly-created MDM Growth Investments announced on Thursday that they had bought a 96 percent stake in Multisource for about 22 million rand and planned to reconstitute the JSE-listed Multisource as a private equity investment firm.
